_note: Standing faculty decisions, machine-readable. A decision that governs code carries `governs` paths, and each of those files carries a `DECISION: <id>` marker at the policy it enforces. bin/check_decision_drift.py checks the two against each other in both directions. Generalised from instrument_rights.json + instrument-rights-gate.mjs, which is this same pattern scoped to one policy. Adding a decision here does NOT create a gate; it creates a claim the drift checker can test.

decisions.title: The SP learner passcode rotates each rotation block
SP_STUDENT_PASSCODE is fixed and does not rotate; a leak needs an explicit same-day change
decisions.note: Rotation WAS the revocation path. Rollback in docs/RED_TEAM_RUNBOOK.md is now the only containment. Never re-add 'rotate the learner passcode' to a checklist.

decisions.title: The no-reproduction rule covers copyrighted instruments only (Option A, #391)
decisions.note: Settles scope, not individual cases. An instrument is exempt only once its status is recorded in instrument_rights.json. If a work package asks for verbatim item or anchor text, stop and ask.

decisions.title: A withdrawal must leave a route — every removed or link-only instrument ships the custodian's official form URL (INV-IR2)
Crisis contacts live in crisis_resources.json only; a page opts in with a marker and the build injects
decisions.note: Scope rule for adding a surface: the learner must plausibly be DOING risk work there — assessing, rehearsing, or planning disposition — not merely reading a page that mentions suicide.

decisions.title: localStorage keys must be namespaced cw_* (shared hub) or rp_* (resident)
decisions.note: Item-id collisions silently corrupt attestation (cw_qbank_attest_v1) and SRS state.

decisions.title: COWS' 45 verbatim anchors stay published under a recorded interim waiver pending the Taylor & Francis letter
decisions.note: This waiver is the one thing still blocking Wave 4. An agent must not narrow or lift it.

decisions.title: The week-page pairing block ships collapsed, not expanded
One derived listing is the only source for “what ships”
decisions.note: site_build/shipped_pages.json is generated from every producer and verified against the real build output on every build. New code reads it; it does not read site_manifest.json or cotw_registry.json. tests/shipped-pages-readers.test.mjs freezes the remaining direct readers, and that list may only shrink.

decisions.title: Analytics event keys come from a generated allowlist
decisions.note: Cohorts are 4-10 learners, so aggregate data can still identify. Free text in an event key is the path by which PHI or a re-identifying detail would reach the counter store. Deriving the allowlist from shipped_pages.json makes what can be measured and what ships the same set by construction.

decisions.title: The COWS anchor text is withdrawn; the scale's items and score values stay
decisions.rationaleRef: instrument_rights.json — cows.decisionRef; evidence: research return rq-10-2026-09-10 in research_returns.json
decisions.note: Closes the interim waiver Josh granted himself 2026-08-23. The permission that exists for the COWS covers clinical copying, not publication on a teaching site, and the waiver's exit condition may never fire. Item names and legal score values are facts and remain; the 45 published anchor strings are replaced with in-house descriptors, the same posture the CIWA-Ar took on this page 2026-08-28. A T&F permission request runs in parallel; a license would move cows to cleared. Governs the generator rather than the generated card: check_decision_drift.py scans code and data suffixes only, so a claim on the .html could never be verified.

decisions.title: SBP1 Patient Safety and Quality Improvement is REQUIRED on the adult inpatient rotation
decisions.note: Closes the one deliberately undecided unit in the standards spine. PR 4.11.q and 6.3 place QI at program level, which is why this was arguable either way; it is ruled required because safety-event reporting, disclosure and RCA participation happen on an inpatient unit, and restraint-and-seclusion reduction and suicide-risk QI are inpatient-specific. Ruling `elsewhere` would have asserted a negative about where learning happens — the shape that failed as RQ-10 f3. The ruling creates a real content obligation and does NOT create coverage: SBP1 remains mapped to nothing and is now reported as blocked-on-vocabulary until `safety` splits into safety-risk / safety-systems. Discharging the obligation is RQ-2. All 21 units remain review: pending; this decision is a placement, not an attestation. As of the vocabulary registry, SBP1's only route to being mapped is the proposed `safety-systems` code, which is why vocabulary.json is governed by this decision too.

decisions.title: Provenance references faculty review; it never copies it
decisions.note: Provenance artifacts — release passports and any successor format — reference faculty-review status by pointer to the governance record. They never embed a copy of it. Authority: faculty. No agent may alter the pointer target.

decisions.title: The third-person scenario remains an accepted limitation
decisions.note: Scenario `third-person` retains `decision_basis: accepted-limitation`. Its three recurring mismatches are expected output, not defects, and are excluded from defect counts. Authority: faculty only. No agent may reclassify.
decisions.revisitTrigger: faculty ruling on the c_si proposal family

decisions.title: One canonical statement each for refeeding, lithium levels, buprenorphine start, RLS, malignant hyperthermia and the cultural-psychiatry sentence
decisions.note: D1: the architecture review's §7-A–F statements were approved as written, and any rewording beyond fitting a sentence to its surface needs approval again. J1: the §7-C sentence is the one buprenorphine-start wording for both the architecture and the peer-review remediation. In short — refeeding: higher-calorie start with daily phosphate/K/Mg in mild–moderate malnutrition, a cautious start only for the highest risk, thiamine and other vitamins, no delay to correct electrolytes (SAHM 2022, StRONG 2021, MEED). Lithium: acute 0.8–1.2 mmol/L; maintenance 0.6–0.8 (0.4–0.6 or 0.8–1.0 by response and tolerance); older adults usually 0.4–0.6; 12-h trough about 5 days after a change (Nolen 2019, CANMAT 2018). Buprenorphine: start once objective withdrawal is present, roughly COWS ≥ 8–12 depending on the guideline, and teach no single cutoff (TIP 63, ASAM 2020, ASAM 2023 HPSO). RLS: iron when ferritin/TSAT is low, alpha-2-delta ligands first-line, dopamine agonists no longer standard (AASM 2025). Malignant hyperthermia row and succinylcholine history for ECT (Rosenberg 2015). Cultural sentence per §7-F (Selten 2020). One override is recorded with it (J0): the peer review's EXTRIP 2015 lithium-dialysis wording (R01-001/-002) replaces §7-B's note to leave the EXTRIP lines alone. Governs nothing yet: architecture WP-1b fills the pending canonical_claims.json slots, which is where these values become regex-guarded.
